'''Wyatt Everett''' (also published as '''Wyatt Everet''' and '''Wyatt Evertt''') is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[January 2002 Phoenix tournament]] on 6 January 2002 with Endor Bikes, according to Steve Marshall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3248">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-01-08-a-new-viper-phoenix-az-1-6-02d3248/ a-new-viper-phoenix-az-1-6-02], DeckTech (Steve "BlackViper" Marshall, 8 January 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-01-08-a-new-viper-phoenix-az-1-6-02d3248/ GitHub Pages].</ref> Wyatt Everett also played at [[September 2000 Phoenix tournament]] in September 2000 with Biker Scouts with Guns and stuff, according to Brian Garrison's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1215">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-10-two-az-tournaments-for-you-to-enjoyd1215/ two-az-tournaments-for-you-to-enjoy], DeckTech (Brian "bgkenobi" Garrison, 10 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-10-two-az-tournaments-for-you-to-enjoyd1215/ GitHub Pages].</ref> Wyatt Everett also played at [[2000 Phoenix Mega Tournament (4 November)]] on 4 November 2000 with Endor speeder mike drains, according to Charles Hickey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1457">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-13-phoenix-az-mega-tournyd1457/ phoenix-az-mega-tourny], DeckTech (Charles "Teacher" Hickey, 13 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-13-phoenix-az-mega-tournyd1457/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
